thread:
Anya: Uploading Vesper-14B checkpoint to the intake bucket. Need tokenizer files + provenance handshake. Pinging infra & sec for KMS wrap.

Felix: Got it. Source type? public repo / partner drop / vendor upload?

Anya: Partner drop via sftp to partner-redwood. Contents: model.tar.gz + tokenizer.json + vocab.json + merges.json. size ~12.7GB. sftp://partners/vesper/14b/2026-03-18

Sam: Prioritization: smoke-run + quant baseline first. Product asked for a 2-week bring-up SLA. Can we get a perf sweep within 48h?

Ingrid: Chain-of-custody required: checksum, signed receipt, vendor cert, and KMS wrapping of any secret keys. I need sha256 and signer identity before I approve registry import.

Maya: I'll stand up a temporary intake node on the dev dedicated pool for validation. Will also tag artifact-bot to register the object in the registry.

artifact-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-ingest/vesper/14b/1965432100/model.tar.gz; size: 12.7GB; sha256: 9f2c1b6d4a8e2f7c9d0b3a6e5f1c2d3b4a5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9; uploader: partner-drop; status: pending-provenance

Anya: tokenizer sha256: acb12f4e9d3b7c6a5e2d1f0b9c8a7e6f5d4c3b2a1e0f9d8c7b6a5e4d3c2b1a0

Felix: I'll create the registry entry and set ACLs. Question: store raw checkpoint or convert to sharded/pt-optimized format? My preference: sharded + quant-ready artifacts so runtime can pick correct kernel.

Sam: Prioritization note: mark as HIGH if product confirms target: 1–2% quality delta with 50% cost improvement. Otherwise MEDIUM. I'll follow up with PM on exact acceptance criteria.

Maya: Bring-up checklist (brief):
- verify sha256 checksum
- unpack + smoke text-gen test
- run eval-suite/vesper14b (safety / instruction-following)
- run quant candidates (int8, int4 / GPTQ) on one shard
- collect perf + quality matrix
- push normalized artifacts + metadata to registry

Commands for initial smoke (run on intake node):
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-ingest/vesper/14b/model.tar.gz /tmp/
sha256sum /tmp/model.tar.gz
mkdir /tmp/vesper14b && tar -xvf /tmp/model.tar.gz -C /tmp/vesper14b
python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
pip install -r /tmp/vesper14b/requirements.txt
python tests/smoke_textgen.py --model /tmp/vesper14b
```

Anya: Uploaded vendor-signed receipt to /secure/docs/vendor/vesper14b_signed_receipt.pdf. Also uploaded smoke-run logs to s3://redwood-logs/vesper14b/smoke-1965432200.log

Ingrid: KMS wrap requested. I'll create a wrapping key and request HSM attestation. Please add a 'no-export' flag on the registry entry. Also need vendor cert chain and signer email.

Felix: Registry entry created: registry.redwood/internal/vesper-14b@v0.1. ACL: ml-eng (owner), infra (write), dev-team (read). Tags: intake-1965432100, partner-drop. Storage location: s3://redwood-registry/internal/vesper/14b/v0.1/

artifact-bot: Registry record created; provenance_state: INCOMPLETE -> awaiting vendor signature manifest. Reminder: attach signed_manifest.json and tokenizer checksum file.

Sam: Quant experiments plan: start with GPTQ 4-bit baseline on one shard. Metrics: avg latency @ 1k tok, throughput @ 8 batch, perplexity delta, instruction-following accuracy. Owner: Anya + Maya. ETA: initial numbers in 48h.

Anya: Starting quant prep now. Will post initial perf matrix & quant artifacts to the registry draft path.

Maya: Please add eval buckets in the run: [safety-checks, instruction-follow, instruction-robustness, latency-slo]. Use eval-suite commit ref: refs/heads/vesper14b-intake-2026-03-18

Felix: ACL note: Infra will rotate the registry key after each major import. Ingrid: will you sign off once vendor manifest + KMS wrap are confirmed?

Ingrid: Yes. Also flag: if tokenizer is non-standard (custom merges), request tokenizer-runner tests for tokenization boundary behavior.
